requirement: The system shall refuse to sell a ticket when the requested seating section has no remaining seats for the event.
The system shall compute the ticket price for a sale as the face value for the chosen section plus the booking fee, with tiered fees applied for premium sections.
The customer chooses seats on the map and pays; the system reserves the chosen seats, records the sale and issues the tickets.
The organiser opens ticket sales for an event; the system marks the event as on sale and notifies people who joined the waitlist.
As a customer, I want to see my upcoming events and my tickets so that I can find them at the venue.
As an event organiser, I want to view real-time seat occupancy by section so that I can decide whether to release more seats or adjust pricing.
A ticket may only be resold through the official resale channel and only when the original organiser has enabled resale for the event.
Every ticket purchase must be recorded with the event, the seat, the purchaser, the price paid and the channel, so that disputes can be resolved.
The seat allocation table shall ensure that a seat cannot be allocated to two customers for the same event and that every allocation references a valid event.

-- seat allocation table
CREATE TABLE seat_allocation (
    allocation_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id        VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    section_code    VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    seat_code       VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    customer_id     VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    allocated_at    TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT allocation_event_fk FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES event(event_id),
    CONSTRAINT allocation_seat_unique UNIQUE (event_id, section_code, seat_code),
    CONSTRAINT allocation_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('HELD','SOLD','RELEASED'))
);

CREATE INDEX allocation_event_section_idx ON seat_allocation (event_id, section_code, status);

-- event master table
CREATE TABLE event (
    event_id       VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
    title          VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    venue_id       VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    starts_at      TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    sales_open_at  TIMESTAMP,
    status         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    resale_enabled BOOLEAN     NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    CONSTRAINT event_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('SCHEDULED','ON_SALE','SALES_CLOSED','CANCELLED','COMPLETED'))
);
-- ticket table for issued tickets
CREATE TABLE ticket (
    ticket_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    sale_id        BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    event_id       VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    seat_code      VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    ticket_code    VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    customer_id    VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ticket_sale_fk FOREIGN KEY (sale_id) REFERENCES ticket_sale(sale_id),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_code_unique UNIQUE (ticket_code)
);

requirement: Only customers holding a valid ticket for the event may be admitted through the gate scanning process.
The box office reconciliation job shall produce a report of ticket sales and refunds per event for the previous business day.
